name: python-scanner-class-move
body:
source: the durable spine edge solution.component.python-module-identity —implemented-by→ rust.pyfrontend.Scanner.module_fqn_for, authored while the Python scanner lived in the flat src/pylib lib.rs.

Inconsistency: the pylib decomposition (plan apg-cleanup, phase-04 task-5) splits the crate into cohesive modules, so the moved scanner units gain a module segment in their Rust FQN. The old flat FQN rust.pyfrontend.Scanner.module_fqn_for ceases to exist; the scanner moves to src/pylib/scanner.rs and its method's new FQN is rust.pyfrontend.scanner.Scanner.module_fqn_for. The verifying scan would have shown the authored implemented-by target as drift.

Resolution: re-pointed the implemented-by edge here, before the verifying scan, from rust.pyfrontend.Scanner.module_fqn_for to the already-planned rust.pyfrontend.scanner.Scanner.module_fqn_for (pending until the decomposition lands; the planned Implementation node is kept, no real code authored). The preserved flat FQNs — the rust.pyfrontend module, parse_args, run, Args, usage, read_target_set and ensure_artifact_dir — are untouched. [with coordinator]
